prompt: Some people think young people should spend more time doing sports. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some people think that young people should spend more time doing sports. I agree with this opinion because sports can improve their physical health and also help them develop useful skills.

Firstly, doing sports regularly is important for young people’s health. Many young people spend a lot of time using phones, computers and watching television, which can lead to a lack of physical activity. If they spend more time playing football, swimming, running or other sports, they can become healthier and reduce the risk of being overweight. For example, young people who exercise several times a week are more likely to have a healthy body and good physical fitness.

Secondly, sports can help young people develop important personal and social skills. When they play team sports, they learn how to communicate with others, cooperate and follow rules. They can also learn how to deal with winning and losing. These skills can be useful later in their education, work and relationships. For instance, a young person who regularly plays football may learn how to work effectively as part of a team.

However, I do not think that young people should spend all of their free time doing sports. They also need enough time for studying, relaxing and spending time with their families. Therefore, a reasonable balance between sports and other activities is important.

In conclusion, I agree that young people should spend more time doing sports because it improves their health and develops useful social skills. However, sports should be balanced with education, relaxation and family time.
